channel.title: Uptick
channel.description: Uptick explains the stories everyone is searching for, from breaking news and sports to tech, health and culture, in clear, sourced explainers updated as they change.

item.title: Como vs. Manchester United: Como Rout United 4-1 in Champions League
item.description: Como beat Manchester United 4-1 in the Champions League on Oct. 21. Goals, key stats, what Carrick and Fernandes said and what it means for United.

item.title: SpaceX Earnings: Q3 Revenue Hits $14.6B as Tesla Merger Talk Grows
item.description: SpaceX earnings beat forecasts with $14.6 billion in Q3 revenue, and Musk says Tesla and SpaceX committees are studying a merger. Here’s what it means.

item.title: French Bond Yields Hit 5%, the Highest Level Since 2002
item.description: France’s 10-year bond yield touched 5% on Oct. 21 for the first time since 2002. Why borrowing costs jumped, and what the budget fight and Moody’s mean next.

item.title: Pope Leo Returns to St. Peter’s 8 Days After Lung Cancer Surgery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV held his first general audience on Oct. 21 since lung cancer surgery. What doctors have said, how he looked, and what it means for his November trip.

item.title: NBA Opening Night: Pistons Erase 22-Point Hole to Beat Celtics
item.description: The 2026-27 NBA season opened with Detroit rallying past Boston 121-113 despite Paul George’s 38. Recap, tonight’s games and key dates for the season.

item.title: Trump and Zelenskyy: Rift Deepens as Oslo Peace Talks Open
item.description: Trump says someone else should negotiate for Ukraine as Zelenskyy meets envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo. What’s behind the split and what to watch next.

item.title: World Series 2026: Rays vs. Brewers Set, Game 1 Is Oct. 23
item.description: World Series 2026 is Rays vs. Brewers, two teams that have never won a title. The schedule, TV channel, how each got here and what to watch.

item.title: Alberta Referendum Results: About 76% Vote to Stay in Canada
item.description: Alberta referendum results: about 76% voted to stay in Canada, early counts show. What the result means, who said what, and what comes next.

item.title: Musk SpaceX Share Pledge: One Share for Every U.S. Kid in 2027
item.description: Elon Musk says he’ll give one SpaceX share to every kid in America next year. What it’s worth, how Trump Accounts may deliver it and what’s still unknown.

item.title: France Protests: 2,400 Arrests After Cost-of-Living Riots
item.description: France protests over living costs and schools turned into riots on Oct. 17-18. What happened, why people marched, and what Macron’s government does next.

item.title: Russia Sanctions: Trump Waives Graham Act Penalties Before Start
item.description: Trump waived Russia sanctions and tariffs in the Graham Act days before they began. What the law did, why the White House blocked it and who is objecting.

item.title: Typhoon Champi: Guam Avoids a Direct Hit, but Half Loses Power
item.description: Super Typhoon Champi’s eye passed 10 miles south of Guam on Oct. 18. What it did to the island, why it wasn’t worse and where the typhoon goes next.

item.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak Hits an 8th Province as Cases Pass 9,000
item.description: Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached North Ubangi, on the border with the Central African Republic. The numbers, why it’s hard to stop and what’s next.

item.title: Hurricane Trudy Skirts Mexico’s Coast, Expected to Weaken Fast
item.description: Hurricane Trudy stayed offshore as a Category 2 storm, soaking Jalisco and Colima. Where it’s headed now, which warnings remain and how much rain is left.

item.title: Pennsylvania Measles Outbreak Tops 1,200 Cases: What to Know
item.description: Pennsylvania’s measles outbreak has passed 1,200 cases, the state’s largest in decades. Symptoms, who’s at risk, and how to protect your family.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Attacks: Why Ships Are Sinking and Why It Matters
item.description: Two cargo ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz this week as attacks on shipping surged. What happened, who says what, and why it hits fuel prices.

item.title: September CPI: Inflation Jumps to 3.7% as Gas Prices Soar
item.description: U.S. inflation rose to 3.7% in September as gasoline jumped 34% from a year ago. What drove it, what it means for paychecks, and the Fed’s next move.

item.title: TSMC Earnings: Record Q3 Profit Jumps 69% on AI Chip Demand
item.description: TSMC’s third-quarter profit rose 68.7% to a record NT$763 billion as AI demand outran supply. The key numbers, what’s driving them and the outlook.

item.title: Brewers Sweep Dodgers to Reach First World Series Since 1982
item.description: Milwaukee rallied from 4-0 down to finish a four-game NLCS sweep of the two-time champion Dodgers. How it happened and when the World Series starts.

item.title: DV Lottery 2027: Judge Orders the Green Card Lottery to Open
item.description: A federal judge ordered the State Department to run the DV-2027 green card lottery. The new dates, the catch for winners, and how to enter safely.
